mainEntity.name: What factors can increase or decrease a tiny home's assessed value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence a tiny home's assessed value. Positive influences include high-quality construction, efficient use of space, premium materials, desirable location, and permanent foundation status. Features like full-sized appliances, energy efficiency, and functional outdoor space can also increase value. Conversely, factors that can decrease value include poor construction, deferred maintenance, unpermitted modifications, limited access to utilities, a less desirable location, or being classified as a recreational vehicle without a permanent base, which can affect financing options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Value increases with quality construction, good location, and permanent foundation. It decreases with poor condition, unpermitted work, and challenging access to utilities.
